explanation: length counts every character, the two spaces at the end too, so it gives 11, not 9. TRIM removes the outer spaces and UPPER the lower case, giving VM-000022. substring(text, 4, 6) starts at the fourth character, counting from 1, and keeps 6 characters: 000022. Reading 6 as the position to stop at would give only 000, and counting from 0 would start one character late.
